blocks.title:
Things we would say
on the call anyway.
blocks.sub: Short and opinionated, written by the people doing the work. No newsletter, no pop-up, no reading time invented.

blocks.title: Disagree with one? Thirty minutes, and bring the counter-argument.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
blocks.emailLine: Or email [HELLO@HOPSIG.COM] — reply within one working day.
